purpose: Read the Windows virtual desktop monitor layout while keeping physical 3-D geometry and screen mutation closed.

activities.label: enumerate logical Windows monitor layout without physical inference

queries.question: Can VIZZ version the logical Windows monitor layout without claiming that pixel rectangles are physical monitor planes?

assumptions: Windows virtual-screen rectangles are logical desktop coordinates, not a physical 3-D reconstruction.
A layout version is sufficient to invalidate a calibration after a logical monitor configuration change.
DPI and orientation are optional observations and do not establish monitor dimensions or eye distance.
kill_tests: No camera, network or screen mutation is allowed.
Non-Windows or API failure returns explicit UNKNOWN.
Physical monitor size and plane must remain unknown in this probe.
Coordinates outside the primary origin must be preserved.
unknowns: Physical dimensions and pose of each monitor on the current desk.
Eye centers and camera extrinsics needed to intersect a gaze ray with a physical plane.
Whether logical layout changes correlate with a useful VIZZ perceptual adaptation.
